newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa says mulls offshore equity issue.
newsitem.headline: Absa says mulls offshore equity issue.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) announced on Monday that it was considering an international equity offering to international investors in the form of ordinary shares and Global Depositary Receipts representing ordinary shares.
Absa said a formal decision as to whether to proceed with the offering, and the size of the issue, will be made in due course, subject to market conditions and governmental and regulatory approvals.
"Absa intends to use the proceeds of any such offering to refinance and expand its international operations," it said in a statement.
